note: This scene IS the claim: 'relative coordinates resolve per aspect'. It previously used x:60/w:1800, absolute pixels tuned for a 1920-wide canvas, so at 9:16 (1080 wide) the 1800-wide text box overflowed by 780px and the word 'ratio.' was cut clean off the frame. The one beat that advertises the layout system was the one beat hand-computing pixels, and it refuted itself on screen. Use pin here, forever. Anything with a hard-coded x/w cannot survive --aspect.
